title: Catalog guardrails and staged variant publish flow for new model onboarding
creator: Asha Patel
body:
Summary:
We need a hardened, auditable guardrail and staged-publish workflow for newly ingested model variants so that (a) only validated performance profiles are published to the public catalog and (b) pinning decisions are recorded and reversible. This ticket covers the metadata schema extensions, validation checks, the staged publish API, and the docs updates for the Console and Onboarding runbook.

Progress so far (updates):
- 2025-02-12: Kickoff meeting with PM, runtime, and docs. Agreed on three publish states: draft, staged, published. Decided staged state requires a signed performance-profile artifact and a successful QA smoke-run against a small synthetic workload.
- 2025-02-14: Schema proposal v1 landed (PR #1234). New fields: publish_state, signed_perf_bundle_url, staged_until, rollback_instruction_id. Added notes about backwards compatibility for older manifests.
- 2025-02-15: Runtime integration spike completed. Staging API returns compatible fallback variants when capacity constraints are detected. Observability hooks (trace id and publish_event) added to runtime.
- 2025-02-17: Docs draft updated in Confluence, Console mockups reviewed by Design (see links). Security asked for KMS signing proof-of-concept; scoped as separate follow-up.

Trade-offs and decisions:
- We chose a three-state publish lifecycle (draft -> staged -> published) instead of immediate publish to reduce accidental public exposure and to gate perf profile verification. This adds latency to time-to-publish but greatly reduces customer-facing regressions.
- Signed performance bundles use existing KMS signing patterns but we will not enforce HSM-only signing in v1 to avoid blocking onboarding cadence. HSM enforcement is a P2 follow-up.
- We added a staged_until timestamp to auto-expire staged variants; this avoids indefinite staged entries but means quick re-qualification is needed for long-lived variants.

Acceptance criteria:
- The catalog manifest schema supports publish_state and signed_perf_bundle_url and is backwards compatible with existing ingest flows.
- A PR to the ingest service implements validation: reject publish transitions to staged or published unless a signed_perf_bundle_url is present and the perf-bundle verification job returns pass.
- The Console shows staged variants in a separate list with a one-click publish or rollback action.
- Audit log entries (publish_event) appear in the activity log with trace ids and the signed bundle hash.
- Docs updated: onboarding runbook and Console help pages; include step-by-step for pinning and rollback.

Links and artifacts:
- Confluence (design + runbook): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CATALOG/Guardrails+and+Staged+Publish+Runbook
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/catalog-service/pull/1234 (schema + validation)
- Runtime spike PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/789
- Console mockups: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B-example-console-mockups
- QA smoke dashboard (Grafana): https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/model-onboard-smoke/overview?orgId=1

Open questions / blockers:
- Security: do we require HSM signing for v1? (security suggested P2; decision pending).
- QA: need a stable synthetic workload and cost estimate for automated smoke runs (SRE to advise).
- Rollout plan: we need a canary policy for console visibility changes; UX approved minimal list view but engineering to add feature flags.

Next steps (owner assignments):
- Diego: finalize validation logic and wire up perf-bundle verifier job (ETA 2025-02-20).
- Priya (PM): finalize staged TTL policy and customer communication template (ETA 2025-02-18).
- Maya (Design): hand off final console assets and accessibility notes (ETA 2025-02-19).
- QA/SRE: add smoke workload job and Grafana dashboard to existing nightly smoke (assigned: Leo, ETA 2025-02-24).

Rollback/playbook snippet (for runbook):
1) Identify staged variant and signed bundle hash in activity log.
2) If perf regression detected, trigger rollback action which moves variant back to draft and populates rollback_instruction_id.
3) Notify model-owner alias and open a regression triage ticket with perf benchmarks attached.

Expected follow-ups (separate tickets):
- HSM-only signing enforcement (security)
- Long-term retention and provenance (audit)
- UI: per-route pinning UX improvements

PR and review notes:
- PR #1234 has schema changes; requested updates from runtime to include publish_event trace id (comment thread).
- Design left minor accessibility feedback for staged list color contrast; addressed in mockups v2.
- PM approved acceptance criteria; requested an explicit rollback timeline in the runbook.

QA checklist (for merge):
- [ ] Schema migration end-to-end test passes in staging
- [ ] Perf-bundle verifier job returns pass/fail deterministically on synthetic workloads
- [ ] Console feature flag gating works; canary rollout tested on internal org
- [ ] Audit entries contain signed bundle hash and trace id

If merged: schedule a 48-hour watch window post-publish to monitor for regressions and automatic rollback triggers.
acceptance_criteria: Manifest schema has publish_state and signed_perf_bundle_url and passes schema validation tests
Ingest service rejects staged/published transitions without a valid signed perf bundle
Console displays staged variants with publish and rollback actions behind a feature flag
Audit logs include publish_event with trace id and signed bundle hash
Docs (onboarding runbook + console help) updated and linked from Confluence
comments: 2025-02-12 - PM Priya Shah: Kicked off. Need clarity on TTL for staged entries and communication for external model owners.
2025-02-14 - Diego Ramirez: Implemented schema change and opened PR #1234; waiting on runtime trace hooks.
2025-02-15 - Maya Li (Design): Reviewed console mocks. Suggested making staged rows more prominent and adding tooltips for signed bundle status.
2025-02-16 - Security (N. Brooks): HSM enforcement recommended as follow-up; ok to proceed with KMS for v1.
2025-02-17 - QA (Leo): Need cost estimate for nightly smoke runs; will prototype with 100 sample calls to quantify.
2025-02-18 - Asha Patel (creator): Updated acceptance criteria after review; moving to in-progress.
